description:
Lemonpost lets you write, schedule and publish social posts without leaving ChatGPT. Connect Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky once. Then ask ChatGPT to draft a caption, tailor it for each platform, attach an image or video, and send it to your queue, a time on your calendar, or out right now.

Post as a story or reel, add a first comment, or thread a long caption. Check that an account is ready before you publish. Ask what went out, which platform failed and why, and retry with one message. Pull a brand's analytics and let ChatGPT tell you what worked.

Manage more than one brand? Switch between them in the same chat. Working with a team? Save drafts for review and nothing goes live until someone approves it.

defaultPrompt: Write and schedule an Instagram post about our summer sale for tomorrow morning
How did my posts perform this week?
Show me what's scheduled to go out this week
